story: Snowden leak: Cavium networking hardware may contain NSA backdoor
text: The Intel Management Engine always runs as long as the motherboard is receiving power, even when the computer is turned off. This issue can be mitigated with deployment of a hardware device, which is able to disconnect mains power. Intel's main competitor AMD has incorporated the equivalent AMD Secure Technology (formally called Platform Security Processor) in virtually all of its post-2013 CPUs. story: Tell HN: Your account can be deleted anytime, for any reason
text: I use KeePassXC to manage passwords. Save the encrypted file (Password.kdbx, 3 kB) wherever you want. Extra points: For emails, buy a domain like mydomain.com for about $15 a year. This lets you have a stable email address (e.g., johndoe@mydomain.com) no matter which email service you use. Consider [LINK] or something similar. I also use Portmaster when I am on Windows.
